name: Aleksej Lunin
source: The best friend of the protagonist and the link to the rest of the company. A future diplomat, a linguist, the son of rich parents. A sociable and cheerful guy. He met Max by chance, in a conversation on a social networking site, and soon encouraged him to go to university in his own city.
